MIYABISTS2-SWORD_NOTAIL_RELIC.title: Tailless Cursed Blade
MIYABISTS2-SWORD_NOTAIL_RELIC.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Frostfall[/gold]. Each time you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Decibel[/gold]. When [gold]Decibel[/gold] reaches [blue]30[/blue], gain an [gold]Ultimate[/gold].
MIYABISTS2-NO_TAIL_FULL_RELIC.title: Cursed Blade Unleashed
MIYABISTS2-NO_TAIL_FULL_RELIC.descriptio: At the start of combat, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Frostfall[/gold]. Each time you play a card, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Decibel[/gold]. When [gold]Decibel[/gold] reaches [blue]30[/blue], gain an [gold]Ultimate[/gold]. At the start of combat, add a [red]Cursed Blade Unleashed[/red] to your hand.

MIYABISTS2-JINGHUA_NIYING_RELIC.descript: The first time you would take damage each combat, automatically play [gold]Limit Vision[/gold].
MIYABISTS2-SHUANGYAN_LIEZHUO_RELIC.title: Frostflame Scorch
MIYABISTS2-SHUANGYAN_LIEZHUO_RELIC.descr: After triggering [gold]Frostburn[/gold], you can still stack [gold]Frostburn Buildup[/gold]. The damage bonus cap from [gold]Iceflame[/gold] becomes [blue]100%[/blue].
MIYABISTS2-SANLUO_XINGDIAN_RELIC.title: Scattered Star Palace
MIYABISTS2-SANLUO_XINGDIAN_RELIC.descrip: Gain counts from victories: Normal enemies +[blue]1[/blue]; Elites +[blue]2[/blue]; Bosses +[blue]3[/blue]. After accumulating [blue]7[/blue] points, add [gold]Pinnacle of Martial Arts[/gold] to your hand at combat start. After [blue]15[/blue] points, add [gold]Slay All Evil[/gold] instead.
MIYABISTS2-SANLUO_XINGDIAN_RELIC.flavor: "I think it would be perfect for training... if only I could shrink down to its size."
MIYABISTS2-SECTION_SIX_RELIC.title: Section 6 Badge
MIYABISTS2-SECTION_SIX_RELIC.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Support Points[/gold].
When HP is above [blue]80%[/blue], damage dealt is reduced by [red]50%[/red]. When HP is below [blue]50%[/blue], damage dealt is increased by [blue]20%[/blue]. When HP is below [blue]20%[/blue], damage dealt is increased by [blue]50%[/blue].
A will that blossoms in the face of despair.

MIYABISTS2-YANGQI_XIANGNANG_RELIC.flavor: A sachet filled with mysterious energy, steadily accumulating power.
